Nora Li: Heads-up  Peregrine Systems invited Redwood to co-present a 50m joint session on June 28 (EMEA-friendly time). Theyre also asking for a short demo of our Private deployment + an EdgeMatrix hardware accelerator integration and want to announce our listing on their cloud marketplace during the session. Need speaker list, demo plan (and fallback), rehearsal slots, and a swag/giveaway approach that works for APAC/EU/NA. Anyone free to coordinate?
Rohit Menon: I can lead the Private deployment portion (10-12 min). happy to co-author the marketplace announcement bullet. timezone OK for me.
Claire Duval: I can do the EdgeMatrix hardware demo. For safety, propose we have a recorded short demo clip to cut to if live hardware has hiccups. Also recommend a short smoke test script.
Ethan Brooks: I'll handle the marketplace announcement text and legal review for the co-branded collateral. also happy to moderate the panel if needed.
Nora Li: Great. Claire, can you outline Plan A (live EdgeMatrix + Private serving) and Plan B (pre-recorded video + CPU fallback)? Also we need a small canary release of the marketplace listing to verify links.
Claire Duval: Plan A steps: 1) provision private deployment in partner VPC (staging) 2) mount EdgeMatrix accelerator node 3) load model variant: rwrfd-v2-market-demo 4) run a 5-min burst to show throughput and autoscale of the private nodes 5) open Q&A. Plan B: switch to pre-recorded clip of identical steps, followed by live Console walkthrough showing monitoring metrics. I'll add timings.
Rohit Menon: Infra ask: need 3 nodes (2 for inference + 1 controller) reserved for rehearsal window and the live session. Ops-bot, can you reserve those and tag them "peregrine-demo"?
ops-bot: reservation: nodes reserved (3) for tag=peregrine-demo from 2026-06-26T10:00:00Z to 2026-06-29T18:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:
Nora Li: Perfect. Claire, for the pre-recorded clip, can you produce 2 versions: 1) short highlight (90s) and 2) full run (~8m) for the tech fallback? Keep both in raw and compressed mp4. We'll upload to S3 and have links in the CMS.
Claire Duval: Yep. I'll produce both and put them in s3://redwood-media/peregrine-june28/. Rohit — can you set up the demo repo and include a quick-start gist?
Rohit Menon: On it. Repo: github.com/redwood-inference/peregrine-demo. Will include docker-compose for Private, EdgeMatrix driver install notes, and an example workload.
Ethan Brooks: Swag idea: Peregrine will include a digital voucher + physical gift options. For Redwood, propose 100 thermal mugs (APAC-friendly packaging), 200 sticker sheets, and 30 limited-run t-shirts for raffle. Need customs clearance for EU and APAC micro-warehouses. Claire, can you coordinate shipping list?
Claire Duval: I can compile the packing list and weights. ops-bot, please surface the APAC customs contact.
ops-bot: contact: emily.ops@redwood.example (APAC logistics). forwarded.
Nora Li: Great. Recording/visibility: Peregrine requires a captioned recording and a hosted copy on their marketplace listing. We'll also post on our site and include the demo repo link. ops-bot can we auto-trigger the recording and deliver transcript to both parties?
ops-bot: scheduled: session recording + auto-transcript enabled for event_id=peregrine-2026-06-28. post-processing workflow will push video+vtt to s3://redwood-media/peregrine-june28/ and notify partners.
Rohit Menon: Rehearsals: propose 1) tech check 3 days prior (30m) 2) dress run 1 day prior (60m) 3) quick 15m sync on the morning of the event. Time windows: tech check on 2026-06-25 14:00 UTC, dress run on 2026-06-27 09:00 UTC. Confirm?
Claire Duval: Those work for me. I'll prepare a short test harness and a recovery checklist. Suggested smoke test snippet below:
```
# Peregrine smoke test
- check EdgeMatrix driver: edgectl status
- start demo container: docker-compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up -d
- run warmup load: ./scripts/warmup.sh --requests 1000
- verify model loaded: curl http://localhost:8080/health | jq .model_tag
- toggle FALLBACK=true to validate CPU fallback path
- verify Console metrics visible and export snapshot
```
Ethan Brooks: We'll need a short marketplace blurb + co-brand image assets. Legal wants 72 hours for review of the announcement copy. timeline: I need final copy by 2026-06-24 EOD.
Nora Li: Noted. Claire/Rohit, please get demo assets and repo links to Ethan by 2026-06-23 so he can draft copy.
Claire Duval: Will do. Also planning for booth staffing: we should staff 3 people per region for a 90-minute window after the session to answer live queries. Volunteers?
Rohit Menon: I'll cover the EMEA slot. Nora can take APAC overlap?
Nora Li: I can cover the APAC slot early morning and join EMEA handoff. Ethan can take NA.
Ethan Brooks: Yup, I'll cover NA. Also prepping a short FAQ for booth agents with canned replies and links.
Nora Li: Excellent. Last bits: will prepare a slim runbook with owners, rehearsal calendar invites, and the contingency cut-to-video script. sharing that after this thread. thanks all. :party_popper:
